summary: 현재 Fixture Desk는 standalone aesthetic, browser, component, lint gate를 통과하지만 승인된 Fixture Compass 방향과의 paired fidelity는 37.90점으로 차단됐다. 여섯 개 critical invariant를 포함해 여덟 항목이 모두 최소 점수에 미달했다.
decisions: 기존 aesthetic pass는 유지하되 승인 시안 fidelity를 대신하지 못하는 별도 증거로 취급한다.
계약과 reference SHA는 수정하지 않는다. 다음 구현은 생성된 eight-metric correction brief만 해결한다.
다음 반복은 새 runtime-tree SHA와 새 desktop/mobile light/dark screenshot SHA 묶음이 없으면 접수하지 않는다.

gate_results.command: uv run design-ontology reference-fidelity-loop --project-dir projects/world-cup-hub --target-repo projects/world-cup-hub/fixture-desk --contract projects/world-cup-hub/design-system/reference-fidelity-contract.json --screenshot-manifest projects/world-cup-hub/build/system/production/fixture-desk/screenshots.json --review-artifact projects/world-cup-hub/build/system/production/reference-fidelity/review-01-current-fixture-desk.json --output projects/world-cup-hub/build/system/production/reference-fidelity/latest_loop_report.json --json
gate_results.evidence: Weighted fidelity score 0.379 versus threshold 0.800; all eight metrics failed and six were critical failures.

gate_results.command: uv run design-ontology verify-production-ui --project-dir projects/world-cup-hub --target-repo projects/world-cup-hub/fixture-desk --screenshot-manifest projects/world-cup-hub/build/system/production/fixture-desk/screenshots.json --aesthetic-report projects/world-cup-hub/build/system/production/fixture-desk/aesthetic/latest_loop_report.json --browser-evidence-bundle projects/world-cup-hub/build/system/production/fixture-desk/browser-evidence-bundle.json --json
gate_results.evidence: The new reference_fidelity gate failed while component contracts, runtime conformance, lint, screenshots, browser evidence, aesthetic evidence, and style divergence remained green.

blockers: first viewport is prose/KPI/ticker-first instead of fixture-workspace-first
the persistent contextual rail is not present as a first-viewport primary region
the selectedMatchId spine is visually fragmented
mobile does not expose the primary fixture workflow in the first viewport
risks: 단순 CSS polish만으로는 composition과 task priority critical failures를 해결하기 어렵다.
구현 변경 후 기존 screenshot, browser, aesthetic, component-runtime evidence는 모두 새 runtime tree에 맞게 다시 만들어야 한다.
next_action: UI Implementer가 latest_loop_report.json의 수정 브리프에 따라 첫 화면 구조를 고치고, 새 runtime tree와 새 네 개 스크린샷을 만든 뒤 Fidelity Auditor에게 다시 넘긴다.
